summary.text: Adagia, also called the world of mirrors, is a windy terrestrial planet orbiting the supervoid Sothera in the Edge and the main base of the Sunstar Free Company.

bio.text: The Sunstar Free Company settled Adagia and declared itself the administrator of the world.
It then encased the world in mirrored superstructures to reflect extra light.
Stories also describe it as a Summist colony under mirrorscapes and as the home world of Geldan, who picked native flowers there as a child.

status.text: As of the latest material, in July 2025, Adagia stands as a mirror-covered colony world under the Sunstar Free Company.
